This happened to my parents - they bought in 1988 and a few years later were in the position of having the value of the house fall below the amount of the mortgage.  They couldn't sell it because it meant finding an extra $100k to pay to the bank on top of the selling price of the house.

Grade-separated rail is the creme-de-la-creme of fast dwell times because it doesn't stop anywhere but stations, and trains with level floors to platforms, numerous wide doors, and prepayment allow for literally hundreds of people to board/alight in less than 30 seconds.

When you designate a transfer of shares worth $5,000 in-kind, your financial institution must transfer the full amount. They will not shave off the 10% tax ($500) and send $4,500 of shares.

So, for an in-kind transfer of $5,000 of shares, you are going to be forced into the 20% withholding tax range because the withholding tax % is figured on the gross withdrawal which not only includes the shares transferred but also what is sent to CRA.
